thread:
Nina (CS): Heads-up: Aegis Systems sent a model intake. They want to onboard a proprietary 13B tuned for clinical triage. Key asks: private deployment (VPC), HSM keying, strict no-logging, and a short pilot before renewal in ~70 days. Putting details here for triage.
Carlos (Solutions): Are they shipping containers/artifacts or expecting us to pick a public base + fine-tune?
Nina (CS): They uploaded a tarball with weights + tokenizer and a model card that mentions PHI-containing transcripts. Link in ticket. They also flagged that cost is a renewal pain point.
Priya (Eng): Important: need model architecture + tokenizer type (sentencepiece vs bpe). Also whether weights are fused/quantized. If not quantized we'll test int8 conversion.
Nina (CS): Artifact: gs://cs-aegis/onboard/triage-13b-v1.tar.gz (see ticket AGS-2402).
Liam (Security): PHI present -> must run PI/PHI leakage scans and retention review. Customer requires no external logging and must use their KMS for root keys. We'll need a signed DPA and key owner contact.
Carlos (Solutions): Pilot acceptance idea: perf smoke (p95 < 1.0s for typical 512-token inference), 250 quality prompts (domain Q/A), and a privacy stress run (500 targeted prompts + red-team prompts). I'll assemble the prompt sets.
Rylee (CSM): Note: Aegis said they'd convert pilot to paid Dedicated if the pilot completes before renewal. Marking renewal risk high. I'll coordinate pricing options with Sales.
Priya (Eng): For a fast path we can run on Dedicated with customer HSM access (we support wrapping customer keys). Private (VPC + on-prem connector) will add ~10 biz days for infra setup and HSM exchange.
Liam (Security): Quick clarifying Q: does "use our KMS" mean we must perform HSM operations in their network, or can keys be wrapped and held in our HSM with customer control? Need answer before we greenlight Dedicated.
Nina (CS): I'll ask them to clarify. Tentatively they prefer keys not leaving their control.
Priya (Eng): If keys must not leave customer-controlled HSM, Dedicated will be tricky. We can support BYOK via key-wrapping for Dedicated otherwise Private is required.
Carlos (Solutions): Sample runtime config we propose for pilot (staging):
```yaml
route: "/aegis/triage"
model: "aegis-13b-v1"
persist_kv_cache: false
telemetry: disabled
kms_policy: "wrap-only"
canary: 10%
```
Priya (Eng): We'll also need a tiny tokenization sample (a 2-3 sentence file) to sanity-check token offsets. Please request from customer.
Liam (Security): Security prerequisites: signed DPA, HSM inventory and admin contact, telemetry disable confirmation, and acceptance of our runtime audit checklist. Without those, no Private rollout.
Rylee (CSM): I'll loop in Sales on renewal options and get a preliminary committed spend proposal we can show the customer during pilot.
Nina (CS): Can Eng + Security ack whether the Dedicated-with-wrap path is acceptable as a short-term compromise to accelerate pilot?
Priya (Eng): Ack for Dedicated with wrap-only keys, assuming customer provides key wrapping metadata and we get the tokenizer sample. We can start compatibility tests within 48 hours.
Liam (Security): Ack on tentative basis. Full security assessment required before production.
Carlos (Solutions): I'll produce the eval matrix and ops runbook: tests, monitoring dashboards, SLOs, rollback, and canary plan. Plan to demo to Aegis as soon as staging endpoint passes smoke tests.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Aegis onboarding: pilot kickoff" 1 May 9:30am PT. Invite + staging creds sent.
Nina (CS): Added these acceptance criteria to ticket AGS-2402: security signoff, tokenizer sample, eval pass (perf + quality + privacy), deploy plan, and renewal options.
Rylee (CSM): I'll start the renewal conversation and capture extension options in AGS-2402.
Nina (CS): Thanks all. Follow-ups will continue in the ticket. I'll post meeting notes after kickoff.
